ud8.2:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud8.2:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
ud8.2:1.4: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbañcetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
ud8.2:2.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
